body:
Me too. 

Had this also with Version 25 in the beginning but after a while it worked. Don't remember, what (I) changed since then.
Need more steps to reproduce. How are you getting this error? what command you are running etc.

I'm having a similar issue, but not with the component (maybe the exception is thrown before hitting that), I'm having the error with Directives:

`Uncaught TypeError: angular2_1.Directive is not a function`

If I try to import directive as `DirectiveAnnotion`, I get the error: 

`Uncaught TypeError: angular2_1.DirectiveAnnotation is not a function`

Same here.

@mhevery , you can try it out cloning my git repo https://github.com/toedter/angular2-typescript-demo. Currently it is running fine using alpha 22. When you change line 7 in src/main/html/index.html using angular2-a26 you would get the error: Uncaught TypeError: angular2_1.Component is not a function
We were able to repro this and @rkirov is looking into it.
Confirmed, the bundle is broken when consumed through commonjs. I am looking into what caused that regression.
@mhevery @rkirov thanks guys, I really appreciate that. Thanks for all the work you are doing with whole team behind angular :)

Today me and @ludohenin updated the Angular version at the [angular2-seed](https://github.com/mgechev/angular2-seed/) and had the same issue. After digging a while in System.js I found that the issue comes from `angular2/src/core/compiler/interfaces`, after being transpiled to ES5 it gets turned into an empty file. During the dependency resolution phase `angular2/core` is getting messed.

[Here is a very dirty](https://github.com/mgechev/angular2-seed/blob/alpha26/app/init.ts#L3-L9) workaround I did.

issue.title: fix(bundle): makes interfaces.ts non-empty when transpiled.

labels.name: action: merge
labels.description: The PR is ready for merge by the caretaker

issue.body:
System.js seems detect an empty file as global and choke on exporting
symbols from angular2/angular2 (possibly a bug in system.js).

As temporary measure we make sure that the file has some (fake) runtime
code left.

Closes: #2343

body: Thanks for the leads, a slightly less dirty fix is pending. Does anyone know of a relevant system.js issue?
@rkirov I had a quick chat with Guy Bedford from system.js. [Here is an issue](https://github.com/systemjs/systemjs/issues/487) in system.js, which is related with this one.
